explanation: Agrawal's conjecture as on Wikipedia: for coprime n > 1, r > 0, if (X−1)^n ≡ X^n − 1 in (ℤ/nℤ)[X]/(X^r − 1), then n is prime or n² ≡ 1 (mod r). Working in ZMod n polynomials modulo X^r − 1 correctly encodes "mod (n, X^r − 1)". Excluding n = 1 is harmless (r = 1 makes the conclusion trivial). The statement is faithful and open; Lenstra–Pomerance heuristics suggest it is false.
